rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose term for the management of money and assets.

example.english: I’ve recently started learning finance because I want to save some money.
example.traditional: 我最近開始學理財，想慳返啲錢。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 hoi1 ci2 hok6 lei5 coi4 soeng2 haan1 faan1 di1 cin2

rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when someone pays for an undertaking or another person's expenses.

example.english: The company is willing to finance this event for us.
example.traditional: 公司肯出錢幫我哋搞呢個活動。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 hang2 ceot1 cin2 bong1 ngo5 dei6 gaau2 ni1 go3 wut6 dung6

rows.note: Use this when the funding is financial support, sponsorship, or a subsidy.

example.english: The government agreed to finance this project.
example.traditional: 政府答應資助呢個計劃。
example.jyutping: zing3 fu2 daap3 jing3 zi1 zo6 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6

rows.note: Use this when the subject obtains or raises money for an operation or undertaking rather than supplying it.

example.english: We're still raising money to finance it; we haven't raised enough yet.
example.traditional: 我哋仲喺度籌錢，未夠數。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zung6 hai2 dou6 cau4 cin2 mei6 gau3 sou3

rows.note: Use this for the actual funds available to a company, government, or project, rather than their management.

example.english: The company has enough finance to expand its business.
example.traditional: 公司今年有足夠資金擴充業務。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 gam1 nin4 jau5 zuk1 gau3 zi1 gam1 kwong3 cung1 jip6 mou6

rows.note: Use this when finance means an instalment-payment arrangement for buying an item.

example.english: This TV is available on finance, so you don’t have to pay everything at once.
example.traditional: 呢部電視可以分期付款，唔使一次過畀晒。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 din6 si6 ho2 ji5 fan1 kei4 fu6 fun2 m4 sai2 jat1 ci3 gwo3 bei2 saai3

rows.note: Use this for managing a person's or organization's finances, not for funding one particular project.

example.english: I use a phone app for finance management, so saving money is much easier.
example.traditional: 我平時靠個手機程式理財，儲錢容易好多。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ping4 si4 kaau3 go3 sau2 gei1 cing4 sik1 lei5 coi4 cyu5 cin2 jung4 ji6 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use this for finance as an academic field or subject of study.

example.english: I majored in finance at university.
example.jyutping: ngo5 daai6 hok6 zyu2 sau1 gam1 jung4 hok6
